decisions.state_note: o000: Visible window approximately x105–168, y117–180. White region widens toward the bottom-left, with a narrow white strip near the right edge; upper portion is mostly black. Digit remains uncertain.

o005: Window x105–168, y85–148 repeats the upper loop’s lower-right junction: black diagonal band joins a broad right stroke extending below the window. Lower structure remains unresolved; 8 or 9 are hypotheses.

o006: Window x105–168, y117–180 shows black across the top and a thick right stroke around x135–162 extending to the bottom, with white to its left. Lower structure remains cropped; 8 or 9 remain hypotheses.

o008: Window approximately x73–137, y149–213 is white except for a black descending stroke at its right edge, ending near (135,210). No lower-left loop is visible here. Together with the recorded upper loop and descending tail, this supports 9.
